name: ancplua-dotnet
description: MSBuild, NuGet version chains, Roslyn analyzer adoption and layered NuGet releases for SDK-style .NET repositories. MSTest work routes to the mstest-extensions companion plugin.

interface.longDescription: Rules and workflows for SDK-style .NET repositories: MSBuild authoring and review, Central Package Management and Version.props truth chains, global.json SDK pins, Roslyn analyzer adoption and suppression hygiene, and layered NuGet releases with index waits. Read-only audits separate certain fixes from judgment calls and route MSTest concerns to the mstest-extensions companion plugin.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository's build, package versions and analyzers.
Trace this ignored MSBuild property through the imports.
Release this package and move its consumers to the new version.
